method: TypeScript AST: relative imports, re-exports, import type and string-literal dynamic import; runtime means non-explicit-type syntax and includes dynamic edges. No bundler/tree-shaking reachability or SQL execution analysis. Calls are syntactic candidates, not all proven Supabase operations.

bundle.method: Transitive static ESM imports and reexports of scripts in built dist/index.html; dynamic imports excluded. Gzip each JS file independently. CSS, wasm and resources excluded. Sources from emitted sourcemaps, source presence does not prove every declaration executed.
